You see a blue gem.
It weighs 0.30 oz.

    Notes

    Rarely seen in houses, and fetches quite a high value on several worlds, but the value has dropped since it is obtainable through quests. Obtainable in The First Dragon Quest and the Wrath of the Emperor Quest. Also obtainable from a certain daily task, out of Mucus Plugs, and from Gnomish Supply Packages.
